name: io.github.Servosity/jira-service-management-mcp
title: Jira Service Management MCP
description: Every Jira Service Management Cloud request-API (servicedeskapi) and Assets endpoint in one binary

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian API token from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens (Basic auth password).

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_CLOUD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Assets only: your site's cloudId. Leave blank if you do not use Assets; 'cmdb discover' prints it.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Your Atlassian site subdomain: acme for acme.atlassian.net.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Assets only: your Assets workspaceId. Leave blank if you do not use Assets; 'cmdb discover' prints it.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Replaces the request-API root built from your site. Leave blank: set the site instead, because this override also redirects Assets calls.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to drop the MCP server's write tools and refuse any non-GET execute call.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to Atlassian. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
